title: ppg-pda-analysis: pulse decomposition analysis of the photoplethysmogram and its validity as a vascular index
description:
Analysis code and frozen pre-registrations for a research programme testing whether indices derived from pulse decomposition analysis (PDA) of the photoplethysmogram carry vascular information, and whether they can correct pulse-wave-transit-time-based cardiac output estimation (esCCO).

Contains the frozen two-component skewed-Gaussian decomposition, the derived indices (ΔT, RI, SI), the landmark and early-amplitude-ratio comparators, the VitalDB and Pulse Wave Database analysis scripts, and the statistical analysis plans as frozen before the confirmatory analyses. Every script carries a --selftest that runs without network access.

No patient data are included. The analyses run against the public VitalDB and Pulse Wave Database.
